#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
go clean -modcache # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -i -cache # want:go-clean-cache
"$GO" clean -fuzzcache # want:go-clean-cache
rm -rf "$HOME/.cache/go-build" # want:env-path-delete
rm -rf "$(go env GOMODCACHE)" # want:env-path-delete
cache="$(go env GOCACHE)"
rm -r "${cache}" # want:env-path-delete
rm -rf ~/.cache # want:env-path-delete
rm -rf "$TMPDIR/build" # want:env-path-delete
rm -rf "$CACHE_ROOT" # want:env-path-delete
dir="${WORK_DIR:-/tmp/work}"
rm -rf "$dir" # want:env-path-delete
STATE="${STATE:-/tmp/state}"
rm -fr "$STATE" # want:env-path-delete
rm --recursive --force "$GOPATH/pkg/mod" # want:env-path-delete
find "$GOPATH/pkg" -delete # want:env-path-delete
find "$HOME/x" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + # want:env-path-delete
trap 'rm -rf "$HOME/scratch"' EXIT # want:env-path-delete
for d in "$HOME"/.cache/*; do rm -rf "$d"; done # want:env-path-delete
sudo rm -Rf "/home/$USER/.cache" # want:env-path-delete
"${GO}" clean -cache # want:go-clean-cache
cache="${GOCACHE:-$(mktemp -d)}"
rm -rf "$cache" # want:env-path-delete
scratch="$HOME/.cache/$(mktemp -u XXXXXX)"
rm -rf "$scratch" # want:env-path-delete
args=(clean -modcache)
go "${args[@]}" # want:go-clean-cache
flag=-cache
go clean "$flag" # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -modcache=true # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -cache=1 -i # want:go-clean-cache
"$GO" clean --fuzzcache=TRUE # want:go-clean-cache
go clean '-modcache=true' # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -tags integration -modcache # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -cache=false -modcache # want:go-clean-cache
go clean $EXTRA_FLAGS -cache # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -modcache="$want" # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -tags '' -modcache # want:go-clean-cache
go clean -tags "" -cache # want:go-clean-cache
